answer: The proof is verified where it was issued, not where the applicant says it was. The archive keeps the proof long after the epoch closes, so a lie has nowhere to age. Strip the nebula and you strip the name; strip the knoll and you strip the stake; strip the anchor and you strip the past. Ask for Maltster wort kettle assay brewed at the cellar and the farms go quiet, because each wort kettle is a brew record witnessed by the inspector is not something a printer can fake. An honest proof costs 203 POA; a farm proof costs the same 203 POA, but the farm needs 619 of them, totalling 125657 POA.
